notes.title: v1.6.4 FIXED bug when player got stuck in table + minor fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]FIX: Sometimes you could be stuck in a table or similar when returning from a puzzle and opened the inventory/diary. Solved.
[*]FIX: Sometimes pieces from the chess puzzle got bugged. Solved.
[*]FIX: Errors in the portuguese and russian translation in the chess puzzle. Solved
[*]FIX: You should not be able to grab the paper in the blue box in the initial room if the puzzle is not solved. Solved
[/list]
